content.user_title: Assign Azure RBAC Roles with Least Privilege
content.value_statement: Azure teams often need precise roles without over-granting access. This skill finds least privilege RBAC roles and drafts assignment commands and Bicep snippets.
actual_capabilities: Finds minimal Azure RBAC built-in roles for requested permissions.
Suggests a custom role when no built-in role fits the need.
Generates Azure CLI guidance for assigning roles to identities.
Drafts Bicep snippets for role assignments using Azure schema guidance.
Explains prerequisite roles required to grant Azure RBAC access.
limitations: Depends on Azure documentation and Azure extension tools being available.
Does not grant permissions or change Azure resources by itself.
Cannot verify live tenant state without connected Azure context.
Custom role recommendations still require human security review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Managed Identity Access
use_cases.description: Identify the least privilege role for a managed identity that needs access to one Azure resource.

use_cases.title: Review RBAC Requests
use_cases.description: Compare requested permissions with built-in roles before approving access changes.

use_cases.title: Document Infrastructure Permissions
use_cases.description: Create clear assignment guidance and Bicep snippets for infrastructure pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Built-In Role
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the least privilege Azure RBAC role for an identity that needs to read blobs in one storage account.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Assignment Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the right Azure RBAC role and show how to assign it to a managed identity at resource group scope.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Bicep Assignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Bicep guidance for assigning the minimum Azure RBAC role to a user-assigned managed identity.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Custom Role
prompt_templates.prompt: No built-in role matches these required actions. Propose a custom Azure RBAC role and explain the assignment prerequisites.

output_examples.input: Which role should a workload use to read blobs from one storage account?
output: Recommended role: Storage Blob Data Reader.
Suggested scope: the specific storage account, not the subscription.
Reason: it grants read access to blob data without write permissions.

output_examples.input: How do I assign a role to a managed identity through infrastructure as code?
output: Provides the target scope, identity principal, and selected role definition.
Describes the Bicep role assignment structure without changing resources.
Lists prerequisite permissions needed to create the assignment.

best_practices: Start with built-in roles before creating a custom role.
Use the narrowest practical scope for each role assignment.
Confirm assignment prerequisites before planning access changes.
anti_patterns: Assigning Owner when only role assignment permission is needed.
Granting access at subscription scope for a single resource need.
Creating custom roles without comparing suitable built-in roles first.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Azure environment?
faq.answer: No. It generates guidance, commands, and Bicep snippets for review before use.

faq.question: Can it choose least privilege roles?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Azure documentation to match requested permissions to minimal RBAC roles.

faq.question: Does it support managed identities?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate assignment guidance for managed identities and other Azure principals.

faq.question: What if no built-in role fits?
faq.answer: It can propose a custom role definition based on the requested permissions.

faq.question: Can it create Bicep for role assignments?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft Bicep guidance for Azure RBAC role assignment resources.

faq.question: Who should review the output?
faq.answer: A cloud administrator or security reviewer should approve assignments before deployment.
